title: Impact of Intraoperative Arteriography with Indocyanine Green in Preserving the Parathyroid Glands During Total Thyroidectomy With or Without Central Cervical Lymph Node Dissection. A Multicenter Prospective Randomized Trial.
official: Impact of Intraoperative Arteriography with Indocyanine Green in Preserving the Parathyroid Glands During Total Thyroidectomy With or Without Central Cervical Lymph Node Dissection. A Multicenter Prospective Randomized Trial.
summary: Main objective: To study whether using green indocyanine (ICG) arteriography before thyroidectomy to identify the parathyroid glands (PG) vascular pattern decreases the rate of permanent hypoparathyroidism.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients ≥18 years of age with a surgical indication for total thyroidectomy with or without central cervical lymph node dissection due to thyroid disease.
2. The patient or legal guardian can understand the study and agrees to participate by signing the written informed consent.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Previous surgical intervention on the thyroid or parathyroid gland.
2. Evidence of associated hyperparathyroidism requiring a parathyroidectomy in the same surgical procedure.
3. Patients with known contraindications to ICG.
